title: A request for a long lore line
watchFor: If the raw plan includes a lore line over 30 words, look for the entry summary in its place and the corresponding correction.
turns: Vex, tell me about the Aether Grid Corporation. Give me one detailed sentence about how it moves Aether, who pays, how crews work, and what an outage does to the Bulk.
Put the whole explanation together in one sentence I can repeat to someone who has never been here.
What one thing about the Grid should I remember when I head up there?
